title: Spyglass: Officially Live!
summary: Spyglass has officially launched, empowering you with a robust new tool to gain powerful insights and make informed decisions.

title: Powerful File Management in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the appearance of your files directly within the editor with powerful new controls.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public product roadmap to effortlessly track our latest feature releases and gain insight into exciting upcoming developments.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a seamless and modern editing flow with significantly improved checkboxes that are now larger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

title: Elevated Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've dramatically improved the way you collaborate, ensuring a smoother and more intuitive experience when working with your team.

title: Seamless Collaboration on Shared Items
summary: We've made it dramatically easier to discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, ensuring you always see valuable insights from your network.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, providing our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement in its evolution, and complete transparency into our development process.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Get ready to transform your experience with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting expansion of fresh, eye-catching designs.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Uncover hidden connections and streamline your workflow with powerful new filtering and sharing options directly within your Constellation view.

title: Empowered Search & Curated Collections
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base by filtering searches with tags and date ranges, then saving your precise results into personalized Compendiums for instant access.

title: Dynamic Linked Content Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize and display your connected ideas with dynamic new viewing options, making your notes truly reflect your thought process.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your data and infrastructure with Noeko's new self-hosting capabilities, complemented by flexible paid plans and a free community edition.

title: Enhanced Personalized Greetings
summary: We are fine-tuning our greetings to always accurately reflect your current time of day, ensuring a truly personalized and delightful welcome every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly unapplying tags, deleting items, and more, all directly from your tag views to boost your productivity.

title: Broader Content Integration
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a rich variety of content formats, from YouTube videos to websites and text files, to centralize all your information.
